jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - Competitive
jobs.description:
Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

Solutions PMM at Fin owns the narratives that shape how Fin wins in market: the stories the field uses in customer conversations, the narratives that power our campaigns, and the competitive strategy that helps us take and defend ground. This is a senior IC role. You drive impact through the quality of your thinking and your ability to move sales, enablement, and campaigns to execute with confidence.

This role is competitive-first. Your first mission is to establish our compete function from the ground up - the intelligence, the messaging, and the system that keeps the field ahead of a fast-moving market. It's roughly 70% competitive today, expanding over time to support sales plays and enablement as the function matures. In a moment where AI makes it easy to copy features and stand up new competitors overnight, this is one of the highest-leverage roles in PMM.

The Role

You'll build and own how Fin positions itself against the competition - differentiation against our tier 1 competitors, a sustainable competitive intelligence program, and the plays and content that let the field act on it in real deals. You'll decide what "great compete" looks like at Fin and stand it up.

You'll work directly with sales leadership, research, SEs, GTM strategy, and sales enablement. You'll be hands-on with the product, the market, and every competitor's moves.

What will I be doing?

- Establish Fin's competitive function from the ground up - the intelligence, the messaging, and the operating system that keeps the field current without creating noise

- Define our competitive differentiation messaging against tier 1 competitors, and make sure it lands in compete campaigns, content, and field conversations

- Stand up a sustainable, AI-driven competitive intelligence program with Research, Solutions Engineering and GTM - tracking moves, updating positioning, and keeping the field ahead

- Operationalise competitive strategy so the field can act on it: battle cards, competitive plays, and objection handling that reps actually use

- Synthesise win/loss data, customer interviews, and market signals into strategic recommendations that feed back into product, marketing and ICP decisions

- Co-build the proactive compete motion - the sales plays and campaigns that drive win rates, not just defend against losses

- Over time, extend into sales plays and field enablement as the compete function matures - raising how the field sells against every alternative

- Create high-quality core PMM assets yourself, and maintain the competitive 'brain' of context that feeds our AI-first approach

What we're looking for

This role is for someone who is a hybrid: part strategist, part storyteller, part technologist. You move between customer insight, product detail, competitive analysis, and creative expression without friction.

You've done this before

- 7+ years in product marketing, competitive intelligence, or solutions marketing at a B2B SaaS company

- You've owned competitive strategy end-to-end — not just battle cards, but how a company positions itself against a moving market — and ideally stood a compete function up from scratch

- You've turned win/loss, customer interviews, and market signal into strategy that changed how the field sells and what the product built

- You've built content the field actually uses, and can speak to what worked, what didn't, and why

- You've operated where product ships faster than messaging can keep up, and found a way to move at that pace without losing quality

You think and write with precision

- Excellent written communication — you write crisp briefs, sharp narratives, and synthesis memos that drive alignment

- Strong editorial judgment — you know the difference between a sharp positioning statement and marketing language that means nothing

- You push back on vague claims and force specificity — in your own work and in others'

You're product-obsessed and technically engaged

- You read the docs, use the product, and dig into the tech before you craft a single message

- You understand the technical differentiation of AI across the stack — model, app, and infrastructure — and have a POV on where the AI customer service market is going, not just where it is

- You use AI tools fluently in your own work and are always looking for new ways to move faster and think sharper

You operate at the intersection of strategy and execution

- You don't hand off strategy and wait — you take it all the way to the battle card, the play, the field

- Comfortable in a room with sales leadership discussing why we're losing deals, and equally comfortable writing the asset that fixes it

- A systems thinker who builds frameworks and programs others can use, not just one-off assets

- You work well across functions, build trust quickly, and make the people around you more effective

Attributes We're Looking For

- Ambitious and competitive — you set a high bar, think big, and want to win. You'll go the extra mile and you're motivated by building something that leads the market.

- Confident and decisive — you back yourself, optimise for progress over consensus, and value momentum. You ask for forgiveness, not permission.

- Curious and intellectually engaged — you're always learning, experimenting, and asking why. You keep up with AI's pace and use it to improve how you work.

- Tasteful and creative — you understand what connects emotionally with people and draw on design, culture, and craft to create ideas that resonate.

- Impatient and change-oriented — you hate slow and work to fix the root cause. You thrive in ambiguity and love building something new.

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $200,000 - $240,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). We also provide a full benefits package to all regular employees.
Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our  core values .

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.  Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. jobs.description:
Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

In AI, proximity to customer reality is the moat. Even the best model doesn't run itself: it takes someone who gets close enough to a customer's business to make it work, and that closeness doesn't happen on its own.

That's where the Forward Deployed Product Manager comes in. You'll work directly with our biggest customers at the moments that matter most in their journey with Fin, whether that's proving out value in an evaluation, getting a deployment live, or expanding what's possible once it's working, and get them to real, measurable success with Fin faster than they'd get there on their own. What you learn with them feeds back into the product, so every customer after them gets there faster and better too.

This is a very novel role in the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what great looks like at Fin: evolving the playbooks, and shaping how we win and deliver on our biggest, highest-stakes deals.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for a PM who wants real time with customers and hands-on time with the product, and who's comfortable making progress before every answer is known.

What will I be doing?

- Own outcomes for a portfolio of strategic customers deploying Fin. Understand their business, their support operation, and their technical environment well enough that the deployment plan you propose earns trust immediately.

- Run the full arc yourself. Pitch and demo Fin, scope the solution, hands-on configure it (including custom development if required), and unblock whatever gets in the way, whether that's a product gap, a technical integration, or a cross-functional snag.

- Be the AI expert in the room. Customers should leave every conversation with you knowing more about how to get outstanding results from Fin.

- Partner tightly with Sales, Success, and R&D so each deployment feels like one team to the customer, not a relay race.

- Turn what you learn in the field into product. Bring specific, evidence-backed input, not just feature requests, to shape the roadmap.

- Build the playbook as you go: the deployment patterns, templates, and best practices that make the next ten deployments faster than the first.

- Help define what Forward Deployed PM means at Fin . It's a very novel role across the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what it looks like here.

Success in this role looks like your customers thriving with Fin, and the product getting sharper because of what you learned from them. It's product management at its core, not solutions engineering, customer success, or professional services.

What skills do I need?

- Experience: No minimum years required. We care about impact, drive, and potential, evidenced through the skills below, not tenure.

- Customer obsession: Deep empathy paired with a bias for action. You're motivated by solving the real problem and delivering measurable results.

- Communication & storytelling: You can pitch Fin to a room of executives, then get into the technical weeds with their engineers, adjusting depth and tone without losing either audience.

- Technical fluency: You're able to talk to engineers and customers about modern tech stack, from APIs and SaaS infrastructure to LLMs and low-code tooling. You're comfortable onboarding a customer into more technical product setups.

- Evidence-based thinking: You use data, not anecdotes, to make the case for a deployment plan or a roadmap bet, and you're comfortable pulling and interpreting data (conversation logs, usage, CX metrics) to find the story.

- Cross-functional influence: You navigate organizational boundaries easily, and bring people together to get the best outcome for customers and Fin.

- Comfort with ambiguity: You thrive in fast-changing, undefined environments, switching fluidly between big-picture strategy and in-the-weeds execution.

- Operational rigor: Operational rigor: You're highly organized and structured, managing multiple deployments and priorities without becoming reactive, and you know when a moment calls for speed versus polish.

Even better if you have:

- Experience building product for enterprise customers

- Startup or B2B SaaS experience

- Background in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success

This PMM role will lead PMM for our Intercom helpdesk, loved by over 30k customers, and lead on how to market new capabilities that help human support teams deliver great experiences, with help and guidance from AI Agents. You'll shape how we talk to the 25,000+ businesses already using Intercom, build the narrative for an AI-first helpdesk era, and establish Intercom as the obvious choice for teams who want their AI agent and their human support layer working as one

You'll work directly with product, engineering, sales leadership, and the wider marketing team. This is a builder role for someone who wants to work fast, think from first principles, and help shape the future of PMM at Fin.

What will I be doing?

- Shape the ICP and audience for the Intercom helpdesk and additional products for teams - who we're talking to, what their pains are, and what makes them choose us

- Own core messaging and drive cross-functional alignment on what we're saying, why, and how it shows up everywhere - from the website to the sales deck to the customer email

- Define and build the external narrative for the AI-first Helpdesk - what it means, why it matters, and why Fin is uniquely positioned to deliver it - and bring it to market in a way that reshapes how buyers think about the category

- Partner with Product, GTM and Lifecycle on how we communicate product investment and progress to existing customers - turning roadmap momentum into customer confidence that retains and expands accounts

- Build crisp, high-impact enablement that sales and customer success teams actually use to sell with confidence. Work closely with GTM teams to ensure messaging lands with the customers who need to hear it most

- Be deeply customer-obsessed - sit with customer support teams, study how they evaluate and adopt, and turn signal into clear insight that shapes what we say

- Lead launches and go-to-market moments for new products and capapbilties releases, working across the company to deliver impactful launch moments that drive mindshare and pipeline

- Create high-quality core PMM assets yourself: web pages, first call decks, narratives and scripts launch materials. And maintain the core ‘brain’ of PMM context that feeds our AI-first approach

What we're looking for

This role is for someone who is a hybrid: part strategist, part storyteller, part technologist. You move between customer insight, product detail, competitive analysis, and creative expression without friction.

You've done this before

- 5+ years in product marketing, ideally in B2B with a track record of shaping how complex products are understood in market

- You've owned a core product area end-to-end - from ICP and positioning through to launches and field enablement

- You've worked in fast-moving environments where the product ships faster than the messaging can keep up - and found a way to move at that pace without losing quality

- Experience with customer retention or expansion motions is a strong plus

You think and write with precision

- Excellent written communication - you write crisp briefs, sharp narratives, and synthesis memos that drive alignment

- Strong editorial judgment - you know the difference between a sharp positioning statement and marketing language that means nothing

- You push back on vague claims and force specificity - in your own work and in others'

You're product-obsessed and technically engaged

- You read the docs, use the product, and dig into the tech before you craft a single message

- You're genuinely curious about AI - not just as a talking point, but as something you think about, experiment with, and engage with constantly

- You use AI tools fluently in your own work and are always looking for new ways to move faster and think sharper

You operate at the intersection of strategy and execution

-

- You don't hand off strategy and wait - you take it all the way to the asset, the launch, the field

- Strong judgment and the ability to work independently on large, high-stakes initiatives

- A systems thinker who builds messaging architectures and frameworks others can use, not just one-off assets

- You work well across functions, build trust quickly, and make the people around you more effective

Attributes we're looking for

- Ambitious and competitive - you set a high bar, think big, and want to win. You'll go the extra mile and you're motivated by building something that leads the market.

- Confident and decisive - you back yourself, optimise for progress over consensus, and value momentum. You ask for forgiveness, not permission.

- Curious and intellectually engaged - you're always learning, experimenting, and asking why. You keep up with AI's pace and use it to improve how you work.

- Tasteful and creative - you understand what connects emotionally with people and draw on design, culture, and craft to create ideas that resonate.

- Impatient and change-oriented - you hate slow and work to fix the root cause. You thrive in ambiguity and love building something new.

Benefits

We are a well-treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us!

- Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing start-up

- We serve lunch every weekday, plus a variety of snack foods and a fully stocked kitchen

- Regular compensation reviews - we reward great work!

- Unlimited access to Claude Code and best-in-class AI tools; experimentation & building is encouraged & celebrated.

- Pension scheme & match up to 4%

- Peace of mind with life assurance, as well as comprehensive health and dental insurance for you and your dependents

- Flexible paid time off policy

- Paid maternity leave, as well as 6 weeks paternity leave for fathers, to let you spend valuable time with your loved ones

- If you’re cycling, we’ve got you covered on the Cycle-to-Work Scheme. With secure bike storage too

- MacBooks are our standard, but we also offer Windows for certain roles when needed

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

We're building a new function at Fin: AI Product Management. For over a decade, Fin has invested in in-house AI, with a team of machine learning scientists, ML engineers, researchers, and AI designers. Now, we’re expanding this team with product managers who will define the future of Fin AI platform and AI agent.

As a Staff AI Product Manager, you’ll shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for core AI systems that power Fin and Fin's AI features. You’ll work at the intersection of advanced AI research, cutting-edge product development, and real customer problems, helping us build world-class AI products that deliver meaningful business impact.

This is a high-ownership role for a technical, customer-obsessed PM who thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and loves turning complex AI capabilities into simple, delightful product experiences.

What will I be doing?

- Lead a major part of our AI product surface. You’ll own an important area of Fin's AI platform or AI agent and be accountable for its vision, strategy, and impact.

- Deeply understand customers, the business, and the technology. You’ll learn the space inside out: what customers need, where the business is going, and how our AI systems work. You’ll use this understanding to make high-quality decisions and build a compelling roadmap.

- Work side-by-side with a world-class AI team. You’ll collaborate every day with ML scientists, ML engineers, AI designers, and ML researchers. Together you’ll explore new ideas, assess feasibility, evaluate trade-offs, and turn advanced AI capabilities into high-value product experiences.

- Ship ambitious, high-quality AI product. You’ll take AI concepts from early exploration through to production launches. You’ll run fast experiments, define success metrics, evaluate performance, and iterate until the experiences are both effective and delightful.

- Collaborate across the company. You’ll work closely with our core product org to integrate AI across the Fin platform, and partner with GTM, marketing, support, and operations to drive adoption and customer impact.

- Lead through clarity, ownership, and momentum. You’ll bring teams together, communicate decisions clearly, create alignment, and consistently push toward impactful outcomes.

What skills do I need?

- Strong AI and technical fluency. You’ve built or worked deeply with AI/ML products, ideally including generative AI. You can discuss model behaviour, evaluation, prompts, architectures, constraints, and trade-offs with technical partners. You’re comfortable working autonomously in complex technical spaces.

- Excellent product judgment. You balance customer needs, business goals, and technical realities. You know when to push for ambitious ideas and when to iterate quickly. You can turn new or ambiguous AI capabilities into clear, valuable product experiences.

- Sharp problem framing and customer insight. You can independently understand and articulate complex problems using research, data, and direct customer conversations. You translate complexity into crisp problem statements for your team.

- Ability to build world-class product. You collaborate deeply with engineering and design to ship high-quality software. You know how to test, measure, and iterate on AI systems and user-facing AI features. You care deeply about safety, reliability, and delivering customer value.

- Strong communication and leadership. You influence widely, bring structure to ambiguity, and create momentum. You communicate clearly and frequently, keeping partners aligned and engaged. You take ownership and raise the bar for the team around you.

Why you'll love it here

- You’ll work with an experienced AI team that has been shipping AI long before it was mainstream.

- You’ll have real autonomy, real impact, and real responsibility.

- You’ll help build the next generation of customer service through the power of AI.

- You’ll help shape the future of AI PM craft at Fin.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our  core values .

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.  Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
